text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] P1 - GPU decode OOM storm in eu-west-1. Service: streaming-decode. Pager: @mike. Link: <https://incidents.redwood/1732109999>

mike: I'm on pager, pulling logs now. seeing rapid OOMs on decode-worker-32/33
sara: joining. looks like runaway generation, many requests with max_tokens=10000
mike: confirmed spike in output length. not traffic spike, per-request token counts exploded. sample trace below:

mike: ```
2026-03-17T12:02:10Z decode-worker-32 CUDA OOM allocating 2.4GB for attention KV cache
request_id=abc123 max_tokens=10000 sdk_version=2.1.3
```
sara: can we short-circuit at the router? route to smaller model variant or reject huge max_tokens
jwong: autoscaler kicking but nodes are flapping; kube evicting pods after OOMs, some driver resets seen
mike: applying temporary routing rule: if max_tokens > 2000 -> reject w/ 400. pushing hotpatch now
ops-bot: Deploy created: routing-hotpatch-1732110020 by mike
emma: CS: ~1200 requests dropped over last 10m, majority realtime chat customers. prepping customer comms
sara: telemetry shows malformed header from SDK v2.1.3 in a subset of clients setting absurd max_tokens (likely bug)
mike: initiating rolling restart of decode-workers on node-5 to clear GPU state
jwong: kernel logs show CUDA exception and driver reset on node-5, looks like fragmentation + runaway allocs
mike: mitigation in place: per-client rate limit 20 rps + server-side max_tokens cap 3000 (temporary)
emma: updating status page and CS channel with interim message :white_check_mark:
sara: follow-ups: 1) hotfix server-side hard cap; 2) block SDK v2.1.3 or patch; 3) add telemetry to surface client max_tokens distribution
mike: handoff in 45m to jwong for monitoring, will file postmortem draft
jwong: taking over monitoring. will escalate to infra team if we see any more OOMs in next 30m
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked RESOLVED - OOM rate reduced after routing hotpatch and client limits. Postmortem required. End time: 1732111045
mike: creating postmortem in #postmortems with timeline + raw logs
emma: I will compile affected-customer list and CS notes, sending update in 30m
